card.summary: European denim and wardrobe foundations shaped through French vision, Italian making, and German precision.

detail.intro: Closed began as one of the first Italian denim labels before evolving into a wider premium wardrobe brand headquartered in Hamburg. Its identity still turns on denim, but the proposition is broader: precise essentials, measured luxury, and clothing that avoids excess.
detail.focus: The brand's strength comes from long-standing Italian production partnerships, deep material knowledge, and a confidence that does not need theatrical branding to register. It reads as premium through cut, fabric, and restraint.
detail.tone: A quiet luxury language built around material confidence and enduring fit.

card.summary: Scarves and accessories driven by print, color, craft, and a long-standing signature in silk.

detail.intro: Codello grew from a single silk scarf idea into a broad accessories brand with a recognisable visual signature. Material, color, and pattern remain central to the label's identity, as does a persistent attention to craft and detail.
detail.focus: What distinguishes Codello is not minimalism but expression: scarves and accessories designed to add personality, movement, and graphic energy while maintaining quality and brand recognisability.
detail.tone: An accessory system built to inject character rather than simply complete a look.

detail.intro: Cuoieria Fiorentina is a premium Italian leather goods brand from Tuscany, renowned for its handcrafted handbags and accessories. Combining traditional Florentine leatherworking techniques with modern design, the brand creates elegant, durable pieces from high-quality natural leather.
detail.focus: Every product is proudly Made in Italy and designed to offer timeless style, exceptional craftsmanship, and lasting quality.
detail.tone: Placeholder tone copy for a refined accessories brand built around craft, everyday utility, and a polished Italian product language.

card.summary: Absolutely Made in Italy—from the yarns to the finishing touches.

detail.intro:
Daniele Fiesoli is a premium Italian fashion brand from Tuscany that specializes in high-quality knitwear and casual luxury for Women and Men. 
The brand combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design and is firmly committed to “Absolutely Made in Italy”—from the yarns to the finishing touches. It is characterized by luxurious materials such as cashmere, merino wool, and mohair, minimalist cuts, and timeless, elegant looks with a focus on sustainability.
detail.focus: The brand combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design and is firmly committed to “Absolutely Made in Italy”—from the yarns to the finishing touches.
detail.tone: It is characterized by luxurious materials such as cashmere, merino wool, and mohair, minimalist cuts, and timeless, elegant looks with a focus on sustainability.

card.summary: Sharper silhouettes and modern tailoring for independent dressers with a metropolitan point of view.

detail.intro: Drykorn began with a simple proposition: fashionable trousers at accessible prices. From that focused start, it expanded into an international label defined by contemporary tailoring, urban clarity, and a more self-possessed kind of dressing.
detail.focus: The brand speaks to confident individualists. Its campaigns, cuts, and proportions all work in the same direction: recognisable shape, strong styling, and fashion that feels progressive while remaining wearable.
detail.tone: A sharper editorial voice carried through fit, attitude, and metropolitan precision.

card.summary: Technical outerwear that bridges functional protection with a cleaner contemporary fashion sensibility.

detail.intro: Founded in Dusseldorf in 2009 by Bjorn Gericke, g-lab was built around one premise: outerwear should perform at a high level without sacrificing design. The result is a brand that moves between weather protection and fashion clarity with unusual ease.
detail.focus: Its value inside the portfolio is distinct. G-lab occupies the space where technical knowledge, modern silhouette, and day-to-day wearability meet, making it relevant to customers who expect performance without visual compromise.
detail.tone: A performance-led brand made credible through understatement rather than noise.

card.summary: A globally recognised lifestyle label combining denim heritage, accessories, and a more overt sense of fashion image-making.

detail.intro: Founded in California in 1981 by the Marciano brothers, GUESS quickly established itself as a defining fashion name, driven by denim, accessories, and an unmistakable image culture.
detail.focus: The brand carries strong symbolic value: iconic campaigns, recognisable glamour, and a lifestyle positioning that merges American confidence with European style references across apparel and accessories.
detail.tone: A statement brand whose commercial strength is reinforced by visual memory and image power.

card.summary: Italian womenswear with bold shapes, expressive color, and an effortless version of glamour.

detail.intro: Founded in 1975 within the Max Mara Fashion Group, iBlues developed into a total-look collection spanning ready-to-wear, shoes, bags, and accessories.
detail.focus: Its customer is curious, fashion-aware, and willing to take stylistic risks. The brand responds with feminine silhouettes, clean detailing, and fabrics that support a polished but easy kind of glamour.
detail.tone: A more fashion-forward feminine voice that remains wearable and composed.

detail.intro: contemporary elegance. Founded in 1975 in Perugia, Italy, the brand began as a specialist in premium knitwear before evolving into a total-look fashion house offering knitwear, tailored separates, dresses, trousers, outerwear, and coordinated collections.
detail.focus:
The company states that it sources its raw materials in Italy where possible, monitors its production chain closely, uses eco-compatible materials, and incorporates environmentally conscious manufacturing practices.
Quiet Luxury.

card.summary: German womenswear built around feminine dressing, practical coordination, and strong day-to-day value.

detail.intro: Founded in 1982 in Starnberg, More & More has developed a consistent proposition across feminine businesswear, polished everyday dressing, and casual pieces with easy coordination.
detail.focus: Its strength lies in usability. Collections are designed to combine across seasons, maintain value, and support a customer defined less by age than by attitude and lifestyle.
detail.tone: Commercially clear fashion with a softer, feminine practicality.

card.summary: Contemporary premium fashion with expressive color, tactile fabrics, and a strong feminine self-image.

detail.intro: Rich & Royal positions itself as a modern German lifestyle brand, built around premium dressing that feels current, feminine, and responsive to trend without becoming disposable.
detail.focus: The brand's language is carried by fabric feel, color, and considered detailing. It also places visible importance on sustainability through materials, packaging, supplier selection, and production standards.
detail.tone: A premium fashion voice that combines femininity, confidence, and material attention.

card.summary: A lifestyle brand built around soft fabrics, toned-down color, and accessible design with long-term wearability.

detail.intro: Founded in 1992 near Amsterdam, YAYA extends beyond womenswear into home accessories, but keeps the same values across both worlds: comfort, femininity, and a calm, desirable design language.
detail.focus: The collections are known for softness, ease of styling, and a lowered visual volume that still retains charm. YAYA presents itself less as a demographic label and more as an attitude toward everyday living.
detail.tone: A quieter lifestyle proposition defined by warmth, accessibility, and understated charm.

card.heroTitle: True to itself and to its Roots
card.summary: A German label with an Italian sensibility, built around blouses as the enduring center of its identity.

detail.intro: 0039 Italy began in 2000 and built its reputation by rethinking the blouse beyond its conservative stereotype, turning it into a contemporary fashion proposition with longevity.
detail.focus: Its distinctiveness comes from discipline. Rather than chasing breadth, the brand remains committed to its roots, allowing the blouse to stay central while collections evolve around that core with consistency and clarity.
detail.tone: A tightly defined brand built on consistency, signature product focus, and quiet evolution.
